---
name: optimize-docs
description: Optimizes any given documentation files to be clear, professional and well-structured. Use when docs need reorganization, clearer wording, or removal of redundancy.
---

Optimize the given documentation files to be clear, concise, and well-structured:

1. Read and fully understand the file's purpose, audience, and content.
2. Reorganize: reorder sections and content so the most important information comes first and related ideas are grouped.
3. Remove redundancy: merge overlapping statements into single, direct sentences.
4. Polish wording: eliminate filler words, passive voice, and awkward phrasing.
5. Preserve all distinct rules and intent — do not silently drop information.
6. Overwrite the file with the optimized result.
